research.title: Is methane release from the Arctic unstoppable?
research.note: The clearest source for Thaw's hope angle; frames the feedback loop as a dimmer switch, not an on/off switch.

research.title: Seasonal increase of methane emissions linked to warming in Siberian tundra
research.note: Real observational evidence (not just modeling) of the feedback loop already measurably happening.

research.title: Thawing permafrost
research.note: An accessible explainer connecting permafrost thaw to real Arctic communities' lived experience.

research.title: 21st-century modeled permafrost carbon emissions accelerated by abrupt thaw beneath lakes
research.note: A more technical source on abrupt (not just gradual) thaw mechanisms, tying to Thaw's tipping-point moment.

research.title: Trends in Atmospheric Methane (CH4)
research.note: The yearly growth rates of global atmospheric methane, 1984 to 2025, shown in the Climate Scientist data view beside the in-game graph.

research.title: Climate Change: Global Temperature
research.note: Its recent warming rate of 0.20 degrees C per decade is how the game works out that one round stands for about 50 real years.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.
